description: Neurotidy makes free printable ADHD task cards, a free ADHD cleaning checklist, and plain-language guides for cleaning your home with ADHD, written under the pen name Mara Ellery at neurotidy.co.

author.name: Mara Ellery
author.description: Mara Ellery is the pen name of Neurotidy's founder. The guides are built from reading and sorting more than 21,000 real ADHD threads about cleaning and home life, then checking the mechanisms against published research.

organization.disambiguatingDescription: Neurotidy (neurotidy.co) is an ADHD home-cleaning resource: printable task cards, a printable cleaning checklist and guides. It is not a software tool, app, code analyzer or supplement, and it is unrelated to the 'neurotidy' Python package or any product spelled NeuroTyde.

reviewed_line: Sources checked against the papers listed at the end of each guide.
